# Contributing to Home Glance

Thank you for helping improve Home Glance.

Home Glance is currently in public testing, so feedback from different Android devices, manufacturers and launchers is especially valuable.

## Report a bug

Use the **Bug report** template in GitHub Issues.

Please include, when possible:

- Home Glance version
- Android version
- device manufacturer and model
- launcher
- clear steps to reproduce the problem
- expected behavior
- actual behavior
- screenshots or screen recordings for visual problems

You can also open a report directly from the app through **Application → Trouble → Report a bug**.

## Suggest a feature

Use the **Feature request** template in GitHub Issues or open it from **Application → Trouble → Request a feature**.

Explain what you would like to change, why it would be useful and how you imagine it working.

## Test Home Glance

You do not need to test everything. See the [Home Glance Testing Checklist](../docs/TESTING.md).

Testing on different launchers and manufacturers is especially useful.

## Before opening a new issue

Check whether a similar issue or request already exists. If it does, add useful information to the existing thread instead of creating a duplicate.

## Privacy and security

Do not include private or sensitive information in public issues, screenshots or logs.

- [Privacy Policy](../PRIVACY.md)
- [Security Policy](SECURITY.md)
- [Support Guide](SUPPORT.md)

## Development direction

The current project direction is described in the [Home Glance Roadmap](../docs/ROADMAP.md).

Home Glance is an independent project and is not affiliated with Another Widget.
